title: Stroke signs
plain: Sudden weakness, numbness, confusion or slurred speech can be a stroke. Note the time and take nothing by mouth.

doNotGive.reason: No aspirin or ibuprofen with stroke signs: they can make a bleed in the brain worse
Nothing by mouth: swallowing may not be safe
Nothing by mouth: swallowing may not be safe

steps.text: Note the time it started (it is saved when you tap Done)
Measure your blood sugar: very low sugar can look like a stroke.
steps.detail: Below 54 mg/dL: also open Low blood sugar (glucagon, nothing by mouth).

steps.text: Lie down with your head slightly raised. Don't eat, drink or take any tablet.
steps.detail: If you can: measure your oxygen; below 94% put on oxygen.

steps.text: Rest and check your speech, face and arms every 15 minutes.

escalation: Signs not improving or getting worse: follow EMG-NEURO-SYMPTOMS and keep the time it started. The crew and Earth were alerted when you started.
